ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level ratio; approximately 90% high-intensity white pixels vs 10% low-intensity black pixels localized to the trailing edge and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous high-intensity white region across 95% of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is restricted to the peripheral trailing edge boundary and tips. A small low-intensity cluster is visible at the apex of the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth extends significantly into the central fluke junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge of both lobes; peak-to-valley amplitude is most pronounced on the distal sections of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a strong concave curve leading to tapered, slightly dorsally-curved tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Single distinct circular dark pixel cluster on the mid-right lobe; secondary low-contrast mottling visible near the central lower margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned dark linear streaks visible on the right lobe, oriented diagonally from the central region toward the lower-right margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular jagged tissue loss across the trailing edge creating a saw-tooth profile; visible small dark spot on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinct yellowish-brown chromatic staining concentrated at the central base of the fluke near the peduncle emergence.
